purpose: assignment sensitivity calibration; does not replace frozen classifications

method.rmsd: C-alpha RMSD after Kabsch alignment via Bio.PDB.Superimposer
method.classification: argmin among references with RMSD strictly below cutoff

ambiguity_rule.definition: ambiguous if nearest RMSD < assignment cutoff and second-nearest RMSD - nearest RMSD < margin cutoff
ambiguity_rule.interpretation: diagnostic assignment uncertainty; not a thermodynamic population

source.collection_hash_definition: SHA-256 over sorted project-relative path, NUL, per-file SHA-256, newline
source.stored_classification_rule: argmin among states with RMSD < 3.0 Å; unclassified if all >= 3.0 Å
